# Enlive Trips

> > Enlive Trips offers curated adventure tour packages and trekking experiences across the Himalayas, specializing in destinations throughout Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, and Kashmir.

Enlive Trips is a Delhi-based tour operator providing group departure packages, weekend getaways, and seasonal adventure trips to Himalayan destinations. They focus on affordable, fixed-departure tours including treks (Kheerganga, Chopta-Tungnath), winter ski packages (Auli), paragliding experiences (Bir Billing), and multi-day circuits (Spiti, Leh Ladakh) with both bike and SUV tour options.

## Key Topics

- Himalayan trekking and adventure tourism
- Weekend getaways from Delhi
- Uttarakhand destinations (Chopta, Auli, Chakrata, Tungnath)
- Himachal Pradesh tours (Kasol, Kheerganga, Parvati Valley, Manali)
- Leh Ladakh bike and SUV tours
- Kashmir valley packages
- Group departure tour packages
- Kheerganga trek experiences
- Winter ski and snowfall destinations
- Kinnaur Valley and Spiti Circuit
- Seasonal trips (Christmas, New Year, Dussehra)
- Mountain adventure activities
- Budget-friendly Himalayan tours
- Fixed departure schedules

- [Kasol Kheerganga Trek Package](https://www.enlivetrips.com/kasol-kheerganga): Parvati Valley trek package combining Kasol and Kheerganga at Rs.6,499
